answer: Put M=binom(n,2), N=2^M, B=N+1, P=n^(n−2), and Q=lcm(1,2,…,P). Index pairs 0≤i<j<n lexicographically by k(i,j)=0,…,M−1. For 0≤m<N, set a_ij(m)=⌊m/2^{k(i,j)}⌋−2⌊m/2^{k(i,j)+1}⌋, a_ji(m)=a_ij(m), a_ii(m)=0, d_i(m)=Σ_j a_ij(m), and L_m=diag(d_0(m),…,d_{n−1}(m))−(a_ij(m)). Let D_m=det L_m[widehat 0], F_m=det L_m[widehat 0,widehat 1], where hats mean deletion of the indicated rows and columns. Define z_m=⌊1/(D_m+1)⌋, c_m=⌊1/(1+Σ_i(d_i(m)−d_0(m))²)⌋, and E_m=c_m(1−z_m)n d_0(m)F_m Q/(D_m+z_m). Then t_n=(1/Q)⌊log_B(Σ_{m=0}^{N−1} B^{E_m})⌋ throughout the stated domain (indeed, for every n≥2).
